readerCopy.body: The next chapter can begin with a responsibility rather than an exciting announcement. When Saturn trines the North Node, structure and forward movement reinforce each other, allowing a deadline, commitment, contract, title, or long-term obligation to give the future plan something solid to organize around. The path can become easier to follow once the terms stop changing. Responsibility is most useful when it clarifies what is actually being built rather than becoming an end in itself.
